name: Hancitor DLL
desc: Attack flow on an intrusion using the Hancitor downloader.

acts.d: Email campaign aimed to trick the user into enabling macros on a malicious document; delivered via a link to Google's Feed Proxy service
User enabled macros
Macro downloads ier.dll and executes it
ier.dll executed
Hancitor downloaded 2 Cobalt Strike payloads (including a stager) and Ficker Stealer
Multiple instances of svchost.exe launched and injected with Cobalt Strike
enumerated local access
checks for internet connection
scans ports
Hancitor downloaded Cobalt Strike DLL and batch file on victim machine
Cobalt Strike DLL stager does not run unless it is given a specific command line parameter
cor.dll executed
Base64-encoded PowerShell dropped onto the machine
PowerShell loader deobfuscates shellcode and runs it in memory as a thread in the same PowerShell process; shellcode includes a PE file embedded inside
PE file is loaded into memory and executed; beacons out at regular intervals to C2 server for instructions
Visual C# Command Line Compiler invoked by PowerShell script; most likely instructions that the PE file retrieved from the C2 server
Attacker used a custom implementation of Zerologon
Zero.exe executes and obtains the NTLM hash of a Domain Administrator account
Attackers use the Domain Administrator's NTLM hash to authenticate to other domain controllers
Attackers deployed Cobalt Strike beacons on the domain controllers
PowerShell executed on every Domain Controller and used the Active Directory RSAT module to get a list of computers and compiled this list into a file
Executable uses IPs and hostnames from comps.txt and checks if they are online using ICMP scans
